{{- /* The URL a link to an API reference page should use: the page's own, or for a folded member, its section on the parent symbol's page (api-member-anchor.html), since it has no page of its own. Expects: the page. Returns a RelPermalink, with a fragment for a member. */ -}} {{- $url := .RelPermalink -}} {{- with partial "api-member-anchor.html" . -}} {{- $id := .id -}} {{- with .parent }}{{ $url = printf "%s#%s" .RelPermalink $id }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $url -}}
